g.text: Focus a field or cancel to Login / Entry
Completion / timer restores controls; correction stays available
Login, register, verify, resend, reset, refresh,
Success → next step; error → restore controls + recovery
Follow the next named step; verification retains its origin
Field, credentials, token, network or system
Show actionable error; correct / retry / resend / cancel
Session invalid, expired, or refresh failed
Clear unusable session → Re-authenticate at L1
Retry L1 or recover at F1; never confirm account existence
Sign in L1, recover F1, or retry R1
Link or code cannot be used
Resend V8; change identifier or cancel to Origin
Success → V2 / V5; error → Retry V8; old token invalidated
Timer ends → Retry exact originating step; cancel → L1 / E1
Generic failure; restore controls and retain
Retry interrupted operation; cancel → L1 / E1
S5 → L1 → safe return path / Dashboard after sign-in
Shared rules: no account-existence disclosure; OTP, verification and auto sign-in are configurable.
Origin = Registration R1 or Password Recovery F1. Cooldown returns to the exact interrupted step.
Rectangles = screens / actions; diamonds = decisions; dashed boxes = named continuation points.
Every error has a retry, correction, resend, re-authentication or cancel destination.
